item.title: Questions and answers from the ‘Car Doctor’
item.description: Q. Some newer cars (Mercedes as an example) do not have an oil dipstick. This complicates a DIY oil change. Is this stupid engineering or an attempt to save money on production costs? A. We are seeing more automakers doing away with conventional dipsticks. Some of this is financial. Even something as small as a dipstick and tube adds to the cost of the vehicle.
